calienne_PROVIDER_CONTRACT.SYSTEM: The Provider Contract defines how calienne communicates with external AI providers. It does NOT perform provider selection or routing. It defines the execution contract between calienne and any model provider.
calienne_PROVIDER_CONTRACT.ABSTRACTION: Every provider SHALL expose a common interface. Provider-specific implementations must be hidden behind the adapter layer. The orchestrator communicates only with the provider interface. Never depend on provider-specific APIs.
calienne_PROVIDER_CONTRACT.REQUEST: Every request contains: execution_passport, provider_id, model_id, system_prompt, conversation_context, task, generation_parameters, schema_version.
calienne_PROVIDER_CONTRACT.RESPONSE: Every provider returns: status, payload, latency, usage_metadata, finish_reason, provider_metadata, errors (if applicable). Provider-specific formats SHALL be normalized before entering the pipeline.
calienne_PROVIDER_CONTRACT.HEALTH: Providers SHALL report: availability, latency, rate_limit_status, context_window, health_score. The Runtime may use these values for deterministic routing.
calienne_PROVIDER_CONTRACT.FAILURES: Supported failure types: TIMEOUT, UNAVAILABLE, RATE_LIMITED, SCHEMA_ERROR, AUTHENTICATION_ERROR, CONTEXT_LIMIT, UNKNOWN_ERROR. Every failure SHALL be reported using the universal error schema.
calienne_PROVIDER_CONTRACT.TERMINATION: Provider communication ends after a successful response or a failure contract. No provider may directly modify pipeline state.
